basic_details.short_information: Chaudhary Ranbir Singh University (CRSU), Jind, has released the CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 notification for 68 regular faculty vacancies across various academic departments. The recruitment includes Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor posts under Advertisement Nos. 01/2026 to 38/2026. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official university website, crsu.ac.in, from 25 November 2026. The last date for online application submission is 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for CRSU teaching positions must satisfy the qualifications prescribed for the relevant post and discipline. The official bulletins specify different academic and professional requirements for Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor posts. Under the general eligibility route specified in the official bulletin, candidates must have a master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in the concerned, relevant or allied subject from a recognized university. Applicants must also have qualified the UGC NET, CSIR NET or another recognized eligibility test such as SET/SLET, unless they qualify for an exemption under the applicable UGC Ph.D. regulations. The bulletin also provides an alternative eligibility route for candidates holding a Ph.D. from a foreign university or institution ranked among the world's top 500 by a recognized ranking organization specified in the notification. Exemptions for Ph.D. degree holders, including candidates registered before 11 July 2009, are subject to the conditions described in the official recruitment bulletin. Candidates applying for Associate Professor positions must satisfy the following general requirements: Ph.D. degree in the concerned, relevant or allied discipline. Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade. Minimum eight years of teaching or research experience in an eligible academic or research position. At least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. Minimum research score of 75 according to the prescribed evaluation criteria. For Professor posts, the general academic route requires a Ph.D. in the concerned, relevant or allied discipline, a minimum of ten research publications in eligible journals and a research score of at least 120. Candidates must also have at least ten years of qualifying teaching or research experience, with evidence of successfully guiding a doctoral candidate under the specified academic route. The notification also provides an alternative route for outstanding professionals holding a relevant Ph.D. with significant contributions to the discipline and ten years of experience, subject to the official requirements.

content_sections.heading: CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for CRSU teaching posts will involve scrutiny of applications, verification of eligibility and assessment through the prescribed interview process. According to the recruitment bulletin, eligible candidates will be evaluated during interviews on subject knowledge, communication skills, teaching abilities and strategies, research potential and scholarly contributions. Final selection decisions are based on candidates' interview performance. The university states that the mere possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee an interview call. Candidates must satisfy the relevant eligibility, screening and document-verification requirements.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the relevant academic, professional and category documents before submitting their applications. The exact documentation may vary by post and eligibility claim. Educational qualification certificates and marksheets UGC NET, CSIR NET, SET or SLET certificate, where applicable Ph.D. degree and supporting certificates, where applicable Teaching or research experience certificates Research publications and supporting documentation for academic scores Valid category or reservation certificate, if applicable No Objection Certificate for candidates currently employed, where required Documentary proof for CGPA-to-percentage conversion, if applicable Other documents specified in the recruitment bulletin and relevant annexures Candidates claiming teaching or research experience must follow the documentary evidence requirements specified by the university, including experience certificates and applicable employment or salary records.

content_sections.heading: CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates who are already employed must apply through the proper channel and upload a No Objection Certificate signed by their employer in the format prescribed in Annexure-F. The university allows candidates to submit an advance copy in the circumstances specified in the bulletin. However, such candidates must produce the required NOC before the interview. Applicants should read the official NOC instructions carefully because failure to follow the proper procedure may affect recognition of previous employment benefits.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The online application facility for CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to open on 25 November 2026 through the official university website. Candidates applying for more than one post code must complete separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: CRSU Teaching Recruitment 2026 Hard Copy Submission
content_sections.text: After submitting the online application, candidates must send a printed copy of the completed form along with the necessary supporting documents to the university. Submission Address: Last Date: 21 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM IST. The recruitment bulletins permit submission through Registered Post, Speed Post or by hand. Candidates should ensure that the documents reach the university within the notified deadline. The online application deadline and the hard-copy submission deadline are different. Applicants must complete both stages in accordance with the official instructions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for CRSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chaudhary Ranbir Singh University, Jind (CRSU) in Haryana for various academic positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under CRSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 68 vacancies have been announced for the posts of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, and Professor across multiple disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the start date to apply online for CRSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 25 November 2026 for eligible candidates wishing to apply for the notified faculty positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for successful submission of online applications is 16 December 2026. Candidates must complete submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General/Unreserved category candidates are required to pay an application fee of ₹ 2000. Reduced fees apply for reserved and female categories from Haryana.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Assistant Professor posts should not be more than 42 years of age as on the last date of submission of applications.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject field.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates need to send a hard copy of the application form?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a printed copy of the online application form along with requisite documents to the Registrar, CRSU Jind by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CRSU Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of submitted applications followed by a personal interview evaluating subject knowledge, teaching abilities, and research score.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website of the university?
faq.answer: You can visit the official university website at www.crsu.ac.in to access the recruitment portal, detailed guidelines, and further announcements.
